target.name: Nominal
target.founder: Cameron McCord, Bryce Strauss, Jason Hoch

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $2.0B - $3.8B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Nominal is a Series B-2 stage company in AI & Software currently valued at $1.0B, having raised $155M to date. The peer universe consists of nine comparable companies—one public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private firms including Waymo, Figure AI, Scale AI, and Reflection AI—spanning similar valuation tiers within the sector.

Peer-median valuation analysis, the applicable triangulation method, draws from three same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables: Ayar Labs at $3.8B (Series E), Black Forest Labs at $3.2B (Series B), and Field AI at $2.0B (IPO). The peer median stands at $3.2B, with a range of $2.0B to $3.8B. This method reflects market pricing for companies at adjacent stages with comparable sector exposure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.8B to $3.7B, centered on $3.2B—implying approximately 3.2x the current $1.0B valuation. The primary uncertainty stems from the limited peer set (n=3) and stage heterogeneity within comparables: Ayar Labs and Field AI operate at different development stages than Nominal's current Series B-2 position. Capital efficiency and product-market validation relative to these peers would materially influence position within the range.
